लिह्, ii. 2, Par. Ātm. To lick, Hit. i. d. 112, M.M.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लीढ.
 1. Licked,

. Eaten.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. लेह्य, To be licked, Pañc. 61, 12. n. Food,
. Frequent. लेलिह्, लेलिह्य, To lick repeatedly,

.
 --Ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. लेलिहान, n.
 1. A snake.
 2. A name of Śiva.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To lick here and there (figurat.),

. ed. 79, 79.
 2. To lick up or off; to eat, Śāk. d. 7.
 3. To touch with the tongue,

.
 --With आ आ, To lick, to touch,
. n. An attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted,

.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ-प्रत्यालीढ, Eaten. n. An attitude in shooting, etc. = आलीढ, n.
 --With परि परि, To lick, to enjoy,

. Frequent. To lick repeatedly, Pañc. 55, 7 (see my transl. n. 257).
 --With सम् सम्, To lick,

.
 --Cf. λείχω, λιχανος, λειχήν; Lat. lingere, pol-lex; Goth. bi-laigôn; A.S. liccian.

-लिह्, latter part of comp. words, Licking.
 --Comp.
